query: Which synthetic-data recovery experiments (DGPs, noise levels, missing edges) best test our ability to recover θ_t and calibrate the ABM?

response.query: Which synthetic-data recovery experiments (DGPs, noise levels, missing edges) best test our ability to recover θ_t and calibrate the ABM?
response.answer: High noise levels and missing edges in synthetic data with complex DGPs best test recovery of θ_t and calibration of the ABM. Experiments with varied noise distributions and missing data patterns are most effective.
